The official evaluator uses category-specific answer equivalence, temporal
 off-by-one tolerance, updated-fact acceptance, a preference rubric, and a
separate abstention prompt. Its GPT-4o alias resolves to gpt-4o-2024-08-06.
It also offers GPT-4o-mini and a locally served Llama 3.1 70B judge.
The installed 8B answering model is not substituted as a validated judge.
No evaluator service has been invoked by this project implementation.
